In an interview with ThePrint, JD(U) MLC Neeraj Kumar said a wedding is not just about a lavish celebration or a political snub, but raises larger questions about wealth, political patronage and the social legitimacy enjoyed by those facing criminal allegations.
He also spoke about his ‘political rivalry’ with Mokama’s strongman MLA Anant Singh, who was expelled from the JD(U) in October this year.
